title: A WordPress quickstart whose release pins no Claude Cowork plugin is bound to its contract through the latest plugin; a bind that cannot be made never stops the provision
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/wordpress-quickstart.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/import-content-identity.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the test named below.
expect: 'a release that pins no plugin is bound through the latest one; a bind it cannot make never stops the provision' passes: after a bind the marker names the installed plugin in coworkContractVersion (the floor when the version cannot be read) and the reader is asked once, after the bind; after a refused bind the provision still hands the site over, the marker is unchanged, the contract setting is deleted and the reader is still asked once; a reader that fails does not stop the provision.

'🔒 wordpress sealed quickstart that pins no plugin: the site is opted in too' passes: the whole post-up of that road ends with rc 0, one bind, and exactly one content.identity call that comes after the bind.
evidence: Dev provision log of the JA Kinetic WordPress demo (03/10/2026): 'pins no Claude Cowork plugin', marker ja-kinetic/wp7/1.0.2, option claude_cowork_contract absent. Local stands restored from the six released WordPress ports with plugin 0.17.3 (04/10/2026): five bind (inspect bound, 5-24 entities, option+bind+inspect 0.87-1.03 s), JA Essence 1.0.3 is refused against profile 1.0.2 (a slot the release no longer has).
fence: The helper's three outcomes (bound, refused, version unreadable) on the function text itself with the provision's helpers stubbed; the full provision on a host is measured on the dev surface after deploy
